note: static_proof is deliberately absent, not empty. ops:proof-generate's autoPopulateStaticProofFromVerifyRun refuses to overwrite an already-populated static_proof, and the skeleton's {"status":"not_run"} placeholder counts as populated -- so pre-filling it would permanently block the closeout harvest that binds static_proof to the "verify" job of the merge SHA's own CI run. Leaving it absent is what lets that harvest write a measured result rather than a narrative one.
